title: CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE SHEET (HUMANOID)
scaffold_guide_lines: FILL ONLY WHITE EDITABLE INTERIORS. KEEP LABELS, BORDERS, PROFILE FACTS, COLOR KEY, AND GRAY PANELS UNCHANGED.
DRAW ONE CONSISTENT INDIVIDUAL. BASE-FORM AND DRESSED TURNAROUNDS MUST SHARE EXACT ANATOMY, MARKINGS, AND PROPORTIONS.
reference_guide_lines: IDENTITY REFERENCE BOARD FOR THIS EXACT INDIVIDUAL. MATCH THE BASE FORM BEFORE APPLYING CLOTHING OR EQUIPMENT.
SCENE PROMPTS OWN POSE, EXPRESSION, CAMERA, CROP, ENVIRONMENT, AND LIGHTING; FIXED IDENTITY FACTS DO NOT DRIFT.

rows.section_label: BASE FORM: FRONT / LEFT SIDE / BACK / RIGHT SIDE

boxes.label: BASE FRONT
boxes.hint: complete unobstructed unclothed or uncovered base form, front view, neutral A-pose; show only declared anatomy and body covering, with clothing, footwear, carried items, and detachable equipment absent

boxes.label: BASE LEFT SIDE
boxes.hint: strict left-facing side view of the same unobstructed base form and neutral stance; fix head projection, chest depth, pelvis, limb alignment, and silhouette without foreshortening

boxes.label: BASE BACK
boxes.hint: complete back view of the same unobstructed base form and neutral stance; show rear anatomy, hair flow, markings, limb alignment, and silhouette without clothing or equipment

boxes.label: BASE RIGHT SIDE
boxes.hint: strict right-facing side view of the same unobstructed base form and neutral stance; prove every lateral feature or absence independently from A2 without mirroring

boxes.label: BASE TOP
boxes.hint: top-down view of the same unobstructed base form in the neutral stance, head toward the top of the frame; show hair parting and crown, shoulder and hip width, and the outline of the whole body from above

boxes.label: BASE UNDERSIDE
boxes.hint: view from directly below the same unobstructed base form in the neutral stance, head toward the top of the frame; show jaw underside, soles, inner limbs, and the outline of the whole body from below

rows.section_label: DRESSED / EQUIPPED FORM: FRONT / LEFT SIDE / BACK / RIGHT SIDE

boxes.label: DRESSED FRONT
boxes.hint: same front view and body proportions as A1, now wearing the declared primary outfit or equipment; preserve readable silhouette, hands, and footwear

boxes.label: DRESSED LEFT SIDE
boxes.hint: same strict left-facing side view as A2 with the identical declared outfit or equipment; show layer order, fastenings, openings, and footwear construction

boxes.label: DRESSED BACK
boxes.hint: same back view and body proportions as A3 with the identical declared outfit or equipment; show rear construction, seam paths, closures, and motifs

boxes.label: DRESSED RIGHT SIDE
boxes.hint: same strict right-facing side view as A4 with the identical declared outfit or equipment; prove lateral garment, item, and opening placement without mirroring B2

boxes.label: PROFILE
boxes.hint: renderer-owned identity facts from sheet-data.json; do not repaint or add text

boxes.label: COLOR / MATERIAL KEY
boxes.hint: renderer-owned swatches from sheet-data.json; do not repaint or add labels

boxes.label: SIZE / EXTENT
boxes.hint: complete base-form silhouette beside a plain scale indicator for the declared measure; proportions and resting stance identical to A1

boxes.label: HEAD STUDY
boxes.hint: large three-quarter head study showing skull and face proportions, hairline and volume, eyes, nose, mouth, jaw, ears, and resting expression

boxes.label: RECOGNITION ICON
boxes.hint: tight recognition crop with signature face, hair, and fixed identity cues visible

boxes.label: LEFT EYE
boxes.hint: left eye at readable scale: iris, pupil, sclera, eyelid, lashes or brow, adjacent marks, and highlight treatment; compare against the separately rendered right eye

boxes.label: RIGHT EYE
boxes.hint: right eye at the same scale and orientation as E1: preserve independent iris, pupil, eyelid, adjacent marks, and any declared equality or difference

boxes.label: HAIR
boxes.hint: hairline, parting, major masses, front/side/back silhouette, strand grouping, color breaks, and fixed accessories

boxes.label: HANDS / NAILS
boxes.hint: palm and back of one hand: finger count, proportions, nail or claw shape and color, knuckles, and fixed markings

boxes.label: FEET / TOES
boxes.hint: top and sole of one foot: toe count, proportions, nail or claw treatment, sole or pad texture, and ankle transition

boxes.label: MARK 01
boxes.hint: first declared signature mark at its exact body landmark with enough surrounding surface to prove placement and laterality

boxes.label: MARK 02
boxes.hint: second declared signature mark at its exact body landmark with enough surrounding surface to prove placement and laterality

rows.section_label: EXPRESSION DIFFERENCES: SAME HEAD AND MARKINGS

boxes.label: EXPRESSION 01
boxes.hint: head-and-shoulders view of the first declared expression; face proportions, hair, markings, and palette identical to A1

boxes.label: EXPRESSION 02
boxes.hint: head-and-shoulders view of the second declared expression; change only declared expression channels

boxes.label: EXPRESSION 03
boxes.hint: head-and-shoulders view of the third declared expression; change only declared expression channels

boxes.label: EXPRESSION 04
boxes.hint: head-and-shoulders view of the fourth declared expression; change only declared expression channels

boxes.label: EXPRESSION 05
boxes.hint: head-and-shoulders view of the fifth declared expression; change only declared expression channels

boxes.label: EXPRESSION 06
boxes.hint: head-and-shoulders view of the sixth declared expression; change only declared expression channels

rows.section_label: POSE AND BODY-LANGUAGE DIFFERENCES: SAME IDENTITY

boxes.label: BODY LANGUAGE 01
boxes.hint: complete figure in the first declared posture and gesture; preserve anatomy, markings, palette, and outfit

boxes.label: BODY LANGUAGE 02
boxes.hint: complete figure in the second declared posture and gesture; change only declared performance channels

boxes.label: BODY LANGUAGE 03
boxes.hint: complete figure in the third declared posture and gesture; change only declared performance channels

boxes.label: BODY LANGUAGE 04
boxes.hint: complete figure in the fourth declared posture and gesture; change only declared performance channels

boxes.label: OUTFIT / EQUIPMENT DETAILS
boxes.hint: primary outfit or equipment separated into readable components with front/back construction, layers, fastenings, openings, footwear, and motifs

boxes.label: SIGNATURE ITEMS
boxes.hint: each declared stable item drawn separately, clearly, and at readable scale; show identity-bearing wear and construction
